title: SQL alert task in Lakeflow Jobs is now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
The SQL alert task in Lakeflow Jobs now supports all compliance security profile standards that Databricks supports and is available **by default** for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use the task to evaluate a Databricks SQL alert as part of a Lakeflow Job. The task returns its evaluation state as a task output value, so downstream tasks can branch on the result.

See [SQL alert task for jobs](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/alert).
